metric_definitions.convergence_delta: absolute fundamental-amplitude difference between previous and last 10-period halves; reported without an invented threshold
metric_definitions.energy_increment: max(0, E[n+1]-E[n]) sampled after every 0.001 RK4 step
metric_definitions.harmonic_amplitude: least-squares columns [1,sin(h*omega*t),cos(h*omega*t)] over every final-20-period sample; amplitude=hypot(sin,cos)
metric_definitions.harmonic_residual: root-mean-square residual of the same least-squares fit
metric_definitions.linear_error: L2 norm of complete final RK4 state minus eigensolved state
metric_definitions.peak_policy: lowest frequency among amplitudes equal within absolute 1e-12; endpoint argmax is boundary-censored and is not a validated peak
metric_definitions.protected_leakage: L2 final protected displacement difference divided by matched reference L2 norm plus float64 epsilon
